name: RouterEval
description: RouterEval is a comprehensive benchmark designed for evaluating routing large language models (LLMs) that select the best model from a pool for a given input. It includes over 200 million performance records for 12 popular LLM evaluations across various areas such as commonsense reasoning and semantic understanding, based on more than 8,500 LLMs.
reputation: A niche but useful benchmark for model routing research, with limited adoption outside work on LLM router and model-selection systems.
notes: Focuses on routing LLMs and model-level scaling; large-scale dataset with extensive performance records.
